headline: 最有价值的重构是单epoch晚知阈值消费者编码；可省宽中间态或统计后的第二遍，不可省统计首遍。尚无稳accept证据。

versions.mechanism: All Y/U cached; minmax index + temporal delta
Current-epoch first-pass U + provisional bits/certificate; final stats verify, failures replay
versions.verdict: Independent substantive reconstruction; cost gate only

versions.mechanism: V2 retains K nearest-boundary U/positions for final patch
versions.verdict: V2 refinement, not separate innovation; scores unchanged

algebra.scope: MLP sn1 -> fc1 -> current-domain bn1 -> fullrank PSN/sn2 -> fc2; no static BN fold.
algebra.real_identity: Y=SW; U_tph=sum_s A_ts Y_sph; R_t=sum_s A_ts; d_h=sqrt(var_h+eps). For gamma_h>0, bit=1[U_tph >= tau_th], tau=mu_h R_t+d_h/gamma_h*(theta-b_t-beta_h R_t). gamma<0 reverses comparison; V=sign(gamma)U and lambda=sign(gamma)tau restore >=. gamma=0 bit is 1[beta R+b>=theta].
algebra.certificate: For provisional bits z and current V: a=max(V:z=0), b=min(V:z=1). All bits valid iff lambda in (a,b]. Missing classes use -/+ infinity. With per-point changes bounded l<=deltaV<=u, sufficient interval becomes (a+u,b+l].
algebra.scope_limits: Frozen yaml center_mode=zero. K adds positional encoding after BN; extension needs A*position offset. PSN fullrank T mixing, not causal reset LIF.

capacity.assumptions: B64: B bits+2x32-bit endpoints+Kx(32-bit U+6-bit index). Excludes alignment/ports/scratch/tags/source/weights. V0 may need equal Y state; all12 U=1400832000 bytes if cross-frame retained. V2 frees per-layer. Acc24 Y does not prove U width.

filter_analysis.naive_minmax: IID illustration, vanishing threshold shift at quantile p: visit=1-p^B-(1-p)^B; p=.95,B64 -> .96247586.
filter_analysis.two_sided: Unchanged U, crossing mass q: failure=1-(1-q)^B; q=.001,B64 -> .06202504. Not ep34 measurements.
filter_analysis.physical_OR: Any failure forcing 64x10x96 replay yields effectively every group failing at IID q=.001. Channel-major spatial lanes avoid hidden-channel OR; charge gather, weight rereads and full-T failure union.
filter_analysis.historical_bound: |deltaU_tph|<=sum_s |A_ts| sum_i |W_ih||deltaS_spi|. Fullrank T/dense h fanout; tile OR(deltaS) at delta=.01,B64 has union .4744 while nearest margin shrinks with B. Tight per-point weighted bounds may cost near deltaU itself.
filter_analysis.anchor_bug: Sourceversion alone cannot yield deltaS: retain anchor bitmap. Independently refreshed h/t create multiple tile anchors. Co-refresh amplifies compute; multiple snapshots cost state; conservative interval transport progressively shrinks even when later changes cancel.

V2K_review.flow: First FC1 computes current stats; local T-vector U forms provisional bits/a/b before Y discarded. Final stats certify discarded U, patch K retained U, else replay failures. No speculative downstream consumption.
V2K_review.prediction: Previous/prefix stats affect only hit rate. Freeze prediction per(tile,t,h); moving it mid-tile breaks nearest-K no-reentry proof.
V2K_review.proof: Fixed prediction and deterministic distance/index ties make K-th distance nonincreasing. Rejected/evicted U cannot reenter; fold it into a/b by provisional bit. K=0 gives V2; K=B full U.
V2K_review.cost: Top-K insert/comparison, values+indices, scatter, endpoints, metadata IO, validity/tags, T scratch, failed-channel gather. One-sided threshold movement can waste opposite-side K slots. Ordinary broadcast is prior.
V2K_review.increment: Consumer-equivalent encoding before global threshold is known, bounded wide residuals, exact commit/replay. Consumer encoding/BN prediction/range bounds/top-K alone are prior.

producer_and_protocol.stats: V2 pays full first FC1 and mean/variance. V1 needs old Y for deltaM2=2Yold*deltaY+deltaY^2 or recomputes it. k/Gram alternatives must pay; stage0 sample0 Gram offdiagonal100%. Local normalization changes identity.
producer_and_protocol.cost_gate: F=FC1,S=stats,P=PSN,M=wide write/read,C=metadata/residual cost,R=actual replay+gather. Candidate F+S+P_pre+C+R < F+S+min(M+P_ref,F_repeat+P_ref). If P_pre~=P_ref, require C+R<min(M,F_repeat). First FC1 never saved.
producer_and_protocol.commit: V2 final bits only after seal. V1 delta-FC2 needs coalesced final old/new differences and retained raw FC2 accumulators or recompute; stage0 FP32 FC2 state=73728000 bytes. BN2/residual consume numeric values.
producer_and_protocol.numeric: A*BN(Y) -> threshold(A*Y) changes FP reduction/order; moments too. Need outward error bounds vs frozen arithmetic plus original-arithmetic fallback, or separate integer deployment evaluation. Handle tiny/zero/negative gamma, >= ties, eps/overflow/NaN. Real algebra is not ep34 bit equivalence.

closest_prior.name: US20200160123A1, Distributed batch normalization using estimates and rollback
closest_prior.overlap: BN estimate parallel to global stats, channel-mask rollback/re-normalize. Generic prediction/replay is prior. Read example tolerates stats error and retains activations; exact late binary certificate + bounded residual is narrower. No legal conclusion.

closest_prior.name: Gist, ISCA2018
closest_prior.overlap: Consumer-specific sign/location encoding replaces wide stashed values. Backward predicates already known; V2 certifies a later global threshold. Consumer-aware compression not new.

closest_prior.name: ConvReLU++, MobiSys2023
closest_prior.overlap: Reference convolution + selected terms/residual norms bound output sign. Dangerous for V1; no late-BN encoding in read sections.

closest_prior.name: Threshold-Based Early Stopping of Accumulations in Neural Networks with Binary Activation, 2026-08-06
closest_prior.overlap: Exact remaining L1 bound; calibrated approximate binary exits; static BN fold. Algorithmic savings, not circuit latency. Margin bound not new.

closest_prior.name: VSA, ISCAS2021
closest_prior.overlap: Running-stat BN folded into IF bias/threshold; no dynamic late-threshold certificate.

closest_prior.name: INSTA-BNN, ICCV2023
closest_prior.access: primary indexed method3.1-3.2 read; direct PDF failed
closest_prior.overlap: Statistics-derived learned instance thresholds; not exact reuse certificates.

closest_prior.name: DeltaCNN, CVPR2022
closest_prior.overlap: Stored nonlinear state, delta updates and deferred deltas; folded trained BN. Cannot assume fold for no_running BN.

minimal_falsification_gate: Use current-epoch Y/U if stored; otherwise bounded identified capture. m1707 sample_order=0001,0011,0021...; frames are chunks, not adjacency evidence.

Oracle final/provisional bits first: B4/8/16/64, actual h/T replay grouping. Compare cheapest fused wide-save vs full-recompute, charging first FC1/PSN, metadata, source/gather, cold start. Kill if even oracle has no net benefit.
Measure tau error, margins, K0/4/8 coverage, certificate rate, actual replay dot/source bytes, queues/worst sequence. Residual savings must exceed sorting/state IO.

Then original-arithmetic reference/error-envelope gate: uncertified cases fallback. AEE agreement does not prove exact bits. V1 additionally needs adjacent-frame anchors, fanout, bound tightness and stats cost.

qa.limits: Exhaustive B4,U in{-2,-1,0,1,2},fixed prediction0,K0/1/2/4,tau -3..3. Predicate algebra only; not FP, streaming RTL, ep34 or timing.
